blockingIssues.description: The reviewed scaffold commit wired the Delivery Log tab back to legacy `OpsEmailDeliveryFiltersCard`/`OpsEmailDeliveryResultsCard` content instead of preserving the new table/filter/pagination path, introducing a regression against the feature's “Existing functionality preserved — no regressions” requirement.

The feature commit replaced the Delivery Log tab composition with the legacy filter/results card path, so the shipped tab no longer matched the intended redesigned implementation and later required `fix-delivery-log-tab-regression`.

Pagination rendering was gated on `attempts.length > 0`, which stranded users on out-of-range or filtered-empty pages with no recovery controls until `fix-delivery-log-pagination-on-empty-pages` landed.

The redesigned template/email dropdowns shipped with incomplete hardcoded option lists and omitted known in-product values such as `request_received`, `confirmation`, `booking_rejected`, and `restaurant_cancellation`, preventing operators from selecting some existing records until `fix-delivery-log-filter-option-coverage`.

The initial pagination implementation hid the controls on empty or out-of-range pages by gating them on visible rows, breaking recovery and URL-synced navigation; this later required `fix-delivery-log-pagination-on-empty-pages`, and its range math also required `fix-delivery-log-pagination-range-math`.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Adjust the RED-test procedure so regression-only or verification-first fixes may confirm current behavior before adding guard tests, and require workers to document that deviation explicitly instead of marking `followedProcedure: true`.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Multiple reviews (tab-layout-scaffold, delivery-log-data-table, fix-delivery-log-tab-regression, fix-delivery-log-status-sort-order) observed workers skipping or reframing the mandatory RED-first step from `.factory/skills/fullstack-worker/SKILL.md` step 3.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify that tests should exercise the production component/client path rather than duplicated helper markup when validating embedded UI behaviors such as pagination summaries.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The `delivery-log-pagination` review found the added test used a local helper replica and even codified impossible summary text, so the shipped bug escaped despite added coverage.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update manual verification guidance to explicitly prefer the authenticated `app.localhost` Email Delivery route when mission docs note `/dev/ops-email-delivery` can 404 or render shell-only content under `APP_ENV=staging`.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Reviews for delivery-log-error-state and fix-delivery-log-pagination-range-math both noted that mission AGENTS documented the dev harness limitation while the skill still prioritizes the dev harness.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Align mission/library environment guidance so the documented local `APP_ENV` and email-delivery validation surface match reality, including when the dev harness is unavailable and auth fallback is required.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Reviews for delivery-log-data-table and delivery-log-error-state noted `.factory/library/environment.md` says `APP_ENV=development`, while mission AGENTS and user-testing guidance observed `APP_ENV=staging` and authenticated-route fallback.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document the canonical source for known Email Delivery template/email filter values so dropdown option lists stay aligned with queue and mock delivery flows.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The `delivery-log-filters-redesign` review found missing known values because `.factory/library/architecture.md` described the filter bar but not the shared option source.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document how to reuse shared UI helpers like `CopyButton` in tests when they depend on hook/path alias chains, so workers do not inline one-off replacements without clear justification.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The `delivery-log-data-table` review recorded that the worker avoided the shared `CopyButton` because of Vitest alias/import issues, indicating a missing testing pattern in shared guidance.
